item.description: DELHI (Metro Rail News): National Capital Region Transport Corporation Ltd. item.title: Kochi Metro Rail Invites Bids for Water Metro Feasibility Survey
item.description: KOCHI (Metro Rail News): Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) has issued bids for conducting a comprehensive topographic survey work to prepare a feasibility report for a proposed water metro network between Aluva Metro Station and Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL). item.title: PM Modi to Inaugurate Namo Bharat Corridor & Meerut Metro on February 22
item.description: DELHI (Metro Rail News): Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the complete Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut Namo Bharat RRTS corridor and flag off the Meerut Metro on February 22, 2026. item.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹2,254 Crore Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension
item.description: DELHI (Metro Rail News): In a major boost to urban connectivity in the National Capital Region, the Union Cabinet has approved the extension of the Noida Metro’s Aqua Line from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector 142. item.title: MRVC Invites Bids for Signaling Work on Kalyan-Badlapur Section
item.description: MUMBAI (Metro Rail News): Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Limited (MRVC) has floated a tender worth ₹97.48 crore for the supply, execution, installation, testing and commissioning of a state-of-the-art 4-Aspect Automatic Block Signaling system on the Kalyan-Badlapur section of Central Railway’s Mumbai Division. item.description: DELHI (Metro Rail News): The National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) has issued an invitation for bids for the construction of a balanced elevated viaduct and ancillary works for the stabling line between Sarai Kale Khan and Jangpura Namo Bharat stations on the Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut Namo Bharat Corridor. item.title: MMRDA Announces Mumbai Metro Line 12 Extension at ₹8,415 Crore
item.description: MUMBAI (Metro Rail News): In a major infrastructure boost for the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) has announced the extension of Mumbai Metro Line 12, now designated as Metro 12A, at ₹8,414.53 crore. item.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Delhi-Meerut RRTS Corridor and Meerut Metro System
item.description: DELHI (Metro Rail News): Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India’s first complete Delhi – Meerut RRTS corridor and the country’s fastest metro system in Meerut.
